title: Why Caffeine Makes You Restless and Agitated
hook: Caffeine does not give you energy, it only blocks tiredness.

narration.text: Caffeine does not give you energy, it only blocks tiredness.
It does this by binding to your brain's adenosine receptors.
Adenosine is a natural chemical that makes you feel drowsy.
When caffeine blocks these receptors, adenosine cannot do its job.
Your central nervous system then becomes overstimulated.
This overstimulation creates the familiar feeling of restlessness and agitation.
It is not extra energy, but a lack of normal inhibitory signals.
Understanding this can help you manage your caffeine intake.
Have you noticed this restless feeling after too much coffee?

description: Ever wondered why too much coffee leaves you feeling wired and jittery, instead of just awake? It is all down to how caffeine interacts with your brain's natural systems, specifically adenosine. Discover the science behind that restless feeling.
topic: Why you feel restless and agitated after too much caffeine, explaining its effect on adenosine receptors and the central nervous system.
